units: bytes, milliseconds; decimal kB = bytes/1000; MiB = bytes/1048576
method: Synthetic loopback gzip/no-store, authenticated session, three independent browser contexts per locale/CPU rate. English 1440x900; Arabic 390x844. TaskDuration deltas over action/readiness plus 250ms settle; longest observed longtask, not INP. Forced-GC JS heap, not process RAM.
